Similarly,

18 is related to ? → 18 × 6 = **108**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All actors are singers.

All singers are dancers.

Conclusions:

(I) At least some singers are actors.

(II) Some dancers may not be singers.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/008072093c07aaf18b3dde1f81ead13f2efea77adce6435be2ed703116eb3bbc.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) At least some singers are actors → Follow (As all actors are singers and all singers are dancers. As whole actors comes in singers, therefore it is false.)

(II) Some dancers may not be singers → Follow (As all singers are dancers. As whole actors comes in singers which whole comes in dancers, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, **Both I and II follow.**​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"

questions.question: Seven people P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). S is sitting to the immediate left of Q. V is sitting third to the left of S. R is sitting third to the right of T. U is sitting second to the left of R. How many people are sitting between S and R when counted from the right of R?
questions.solution:
**Given:** Seven people P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

1) S is sitting to the immediate left of Q.

2) V is sitting third to the left of S. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed525ff2e31a186bc19510350608ac9eb44bd62dc3e6d0951eb238e4f06e0418.png] 

3) U is sitting second to the left of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74f1fcfe77bb7db67875fc20e7986c7cca4bda15c4ea26e40373ced82ddbdb00.png] 

4) R is sitting third to the right of T.

After positioning T only, one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4dc822267614c550c445a0af6c8b4d3e2350162c9fbe25aa538a72061330595f.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement one person is sitting between S and R when counted from the right of R.

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
This question has two statements followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

Some stones are hurting.

Some stones are beautiful.

Conclusions:

(I) Some beautiful stones are hurting.

(II) Some hurting stones are beautiful
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4d518d2f95874191034ea993a658a87434477a11852b8b7aa3dad88b435f351.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some beautiful stones are hurting → **Does not** follow (As re statement can not be true)

(II) Some hurting stones are beautiful → Does not follow (As some stones are hurting and some stones are beautiful. As some part of beautiful is common with stones which has some part common with hurting, so it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, **Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows**.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"

questions.question:
What will come in the place of ‘?’ in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘×‘ are interchanged and ‘−’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

18 ÷ 6 + 5 × 14 − 7 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/952c967501c582f1911db7fefdaaefa9b6e3f505512624eb925e04e002be5a1f.png] 

Given: 18 ÷ 6 + 5 × 14 − 7 = ?

According to the question, after ‘+’ and ‘×’ are interchanged and ‘÷’ and ‘–’ are interchanged:

18 ÷ 6 + 5 × 14 − 7 = ? ⇒ 18 - 6 × 5 + 14 ÷ 7 = ?

⇒ 18 - 6 × 5 + __**14 **____**÷**____** 7**__ = ?

⇒ 18 - __**6 **____**×**____** 5**__ + 2 = ?

⇒ __**18 + 2**__ - 30 = ?

⇒ __**20 - 30**__ = ?

⇒ **-10**** = ?**

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
